latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Foreign Affairs, and in addition to the Committees on Armed Services, and Intelligence (Permanent Select), for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

aiDescription.summary: The DISRUPT Act directs the executive branch to produce a strategy across federal agencies to disrupt expanding cooperation among the People's Republic of China, Russia, Iran, and North Korea and to mitigate resulting risks to U.S. national security. It covers those four named adversary countries.

impact.summary: The DISRUPT Act requires the executive branch to craft a whole-of-government strategy to disrupt cooperation among China, Russia, Iran, and North Korea. It would involve the Departments of State and Defense, the Intelligence Community, National Laboratories, and federal procurement and research programs.
